div.div: Future implementation content This page is provided to show the expected direction of future implementation work. It is not part of the proposed material for evaluation in this publication; mappings, target artefacts and profiling details are expected to evolve in subsequent iterations of this guide.

Yellow row/cells: In this ballot publication, some row/cells of the mapping table have been left in yellow to indicate areas requiring further review or refinement; including feedback from the Xt-EHR joint action (see note above). These highlights will be addressed in subsequent updates to ensure accuracy and completeness of the mappings.

body.p: This page explains how elements from the SystemicTreatment logical model are expressed in the FHIR Resource ProcedureSystemicTreatmentEuCcm resource used by this Implementation Guide. The logical model describes the whole treatment course (type, intent, period, setting) as a single summary, which is why it is mapped to a Procedure with a performed period rather than to an EpisodeOfCare, which in FHIR represents a care-management relationship and not a treatment. In primary systems the course is typically derived from the individual MedicationRequest / MedicationAdministration resources of the regimen; those are out of scope of the ECCDM.

tr.td: Here the reference to a PatientEuCcm must be made.
Here the reference to a CancerConditionAtDiagnosisEuCcm must be made.
Here the ObservationClinicalCancerProgression can be referenced, if the treatment is delivered in response to a progression.
Extension CancerTreatmentIntent; the code must stem from the Cancer Treatment Intent value set (SNOMED CT curative / palliative).

Category of the systemic treatment, bound (extensible) to the Systemic Treatment Type value set (SNOMED CT chemotherapy, immunotherapy, hormone therapy). A code for targeted therapy still has to be added.
Start date of the treatment course.
End date of the treatment course, if available. It might not be available while the treatment is still ongoing; however, an end date must eventually be recorded.
ongoing = true is expressed as status = in-progress with no performedPeriod.end (invariant ccm-st-1); a finished course has status = completed.
Extension CancerTreatmentSetting; the SNOMED CT codes of the Cancer Treatment Setting value set still need review against the model choices (alone, neoadjuvant, adjuvant, concomitant).
